headline.zh: XCENA 内存瓶颈方案评估

scenario.zh: 你负责 AI 基础设施采购，需评估 XCENA 芯片能否降低推理成本
scenario.en: You manage AI infrastructure procurement and need to evaluate XCENA's chip for inference cost reduction

instruction.zh: 先确定优先测试的工作负载类型
instruction.en: Select the workload type to prioritize

output.zh: 聚焦语言模型推理，内存带宽是主要瓶颈
output.en: Focus on language model inference where memory bandwidth is the main bottleneck

output.zh: 聚焦模型训练阶段，显存容量与速度并重
output.en: Focus on model training where memory capacity and speed both matter

instruction.zh: 调整计划部署的 GPU 卡数
instruction.en: Adjust the number of GPUs planned for deployment

output.zh: 使用现有 GPU，内存瓶颈明显，成本基准清晰
output.en: Use existing GPUs with clear memory bottleneck and cost baseline

output.zh: 加入 XCENA 内存芯片，带宽提升但集成复杂度增加
output.en: Add XCENA memory chips for bandwidth boost but higher integration complexity

instruction.zh: 查看两种方案在成本与性能上的差异
instruction.en: Review cost and performance differences between approaches

output.zh: 硬件成熟但内存带宽受限，推理吞吐量较低
output.en: Mature hardware but memory bandwidth limited, lower inference throughput

output.zh: 内存带宽大幅改善，但需验证软件栈兼容性与供应稳定性
output.en: Memory bandwidth greatly improved but requires software stack compatibility and supply stability verification

instruction.zh: 确认最终技术方向并输出决策要点
instruction.en: Confirm final technical direction and output decision points

output.zh: 建议先小规模试点 XCENA 方案，同时保留标准 GPU 主力部署
output.en: Recommend small-scale XCENA pilot while keeping standard GPU as main deployment

output.zh: 建议大比例采用 XCENA 方案，需同步评估供应链与技术支持
output.en: Recommend high XCENA adoption ratio with parallel supply chain and support evaluation

takeaway.zh: 完成对 XCENA 内存芯片的架构评估，明确其在 AI 推理成本优化中的潜在价值与集成风险
takeaway.en: Completed architecture evaluation of XCENA memory chip, clarifying its potential value and integration risks in AI inference cost optimization
